blocked.name: Kishimojin Daimon Keyaki Namiki (Avenue of Japanese Zelkovas)

location.address: Kishimojin Daimon approach, Zoshigaya 3-16/19, Toshima-ku, Tokyo

blocked.reason: Not a single collectible point. It is a roughly 200m processional avenue that held 18 large zelkovas in 1937; several of the old trees have since died and been replaced with young saplings by a preservation society, so there is no longer one obvious specimen or even a uniformly aged row to stand at. This project's own Zoshigaya Kishimojin Ginkgo (verified this pass as tok_021, roughly 60m away at the same temple) is the genuinely worth-the-visit single tree at this site, and it ships instead. The avenue itself is left blocked rather than shipped as an ensemble, unlike Meiji Jingu Gaien (tok_009): that avenue is famous specifically as a uniform, photographed whole; this one is a patchwork of old and new after losses.

blocked.name: Sakura shogakko no Oakagashi (Big Quercus Acuta at Sakura Elementary School)

location.address: Sakura Elementary School, 2-4-15 Setagaya, Setagaya-ku, Tokyo

blocked.reason: Sits on a working elementary school's grounds. No evidence found in a brief search that the schoolyard is genuinely open to the public (no public path through it, no stated weekend opening). Per hard rule 10's school exception, this stays blocked absent that evidence rather than sending adult strangers onto school property during unknown hours. A future pass could check the school's own site or call to ask, or look for OSM access tags on the grounds.
